$comment: SUBC relay conformance vectors for the admission-facts surface (spec v5 @ c5aa69d8, contract v7.3 @ f02d9b2f). Each vector cites the clause it proves. Sizes are computed over the compact serde_json::to_vec serialization of the post-parse value (spec §3.1's pinned metric). Verdicts: relay = subc-core daemon behavior; validate = alfonso-side §3.1 validator behavior (vendored here because the schemas are spec-normative; ALF's suite consumes these ids).

vectors.$comment: THE tolerance centerpiece: an unknown NON-forbidden field must pass end-to-end (fed emit posture, subc opaque relay, alfonso validate-accept). A deny-unknown-fields validator fails this vector and is a contract violation.

vectors.clause: spec §3.1 member forbidden set; presence is by key, value irrelevant
vectors.$comment: grant_id is FORBIDDEN on member packages even with a null value — rejection is by key presence.

vectors.clause: spec §3.1 service forbidden set (shared-pipe rule: per-turn subjects are A3 call metadata, never bind facts)
spec §3.1 epoch numerics: JSON integers 0..2^53-1; fractional/negative/string-typed reject
vectors.$comment: membership_epoch string-typed. Companion negatives (fractional 7.5, negative -1) share this id family as -b/-c if a suite wants them enumerated separately.

vectors.clause: spec §3.2 carrier identity; daemon rejects facts from any principal but the configured reserved module
vectors.setup: route.open with admission_facts from a direct (non-reserved) client

vectors.clause: spec §3.2 mandatory target allowlist; exact module-id equality; positioned after existence/role/liveness, before reservation
vectors.setup: authorized carrier, facts-bearing open toward a target module absent from admission_facts_targets

vectors.clause: spec §3.2 pinned precedence: target existence before carrier gate
vectors.setup: unauthorized carrier, facts-bearing open toward a NONEXISTENT target
vectors.$comment: Asserts the shipped precedence: existence checks run first, so unknown_module wins over admission_facts_not_permitted.

vectors.clause: spec §4 one-shot SDK: at most one route.open frame per invocation; no cache entry, no auto-reopen, no facts resend
vectors.setup: open_route_with_admission_facts through disconnect / timeout / retryable-daemon-error paths

expect.sdk: at-most-one-frame; error surfaces to caller; no reopen

vectors.clause: spec §3.1 size metric: compact serialization == 4096 bytes accepts
vectors.construction: member package padded via a single unknown benign string field to exactly 4096 compact bytes

vectors.clause: spec §3.1 size metric: 4097 compact bytes rejects
spec §3.1 depth: root=1, max 3; depth-4 rejects; checks precede unknown-field tolerance
vectors.construction: unknown benign field carrying an object nested to depth 4
vectors.$comment: The ignored unknown field still counts toward size and depth — tolerance never exempts a field from the resource bounds.
